columns.name: full_name
columns.description: Full name of the client. Concatenates the first name, middle name, and last name, separated by a space.

columns.name: issue_with_the_longest_server_time
columns.description: The issue that the client with the longest server time faced,with ties broken by the ascending order of the issue

columns.name: days_of_longest_delay_of_complaint
columns.description: The number of days of the longest delay in the client’s complaint. Delay refers to the time between when the complaint was received and when it was sent to the company.

columns.name: has_in_progress_complaints
columns.description: Set to 1 if the client has in progress complaints, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: percentage_of_complaint_calls_got_consent
columns.description: The percentage of complaint calls that got consent of all complaints for the client .

columns.name: number_of_complaint_submitted_via_fax
columns.description: The number of complaints submitted via fax, replace NULL values with 0.
